title: TAG package extension (plugin.json extensions["com.theapotheosisgroup.tag-skills"])
description: TAG's client-owned data in an Agent Plugins 1.0.0 manifest: which skills the package ships and the lowest plan tier each belongs to. Tiers are cumulative: foundation < structure < turnkey. It grants no access.

tier.description: The lowest plan tier that includes the skill; every higher tier includes it too.
